meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Unrestrained
meta.description: The thoughts embedded in the code transcend 0s and 1s.

units.rawText: <color=red>Your hands are already drenched with blood.</color>
units.displayText: Your hands are already drenched with blood.

spans.text: Your hands are already drenched with blood.

units.rawText: <color=red>You've long forgotten where that blood flows from, no? The blood of enemies, of friends...</color>
units.displayText: You've long forgotten where that blood flows from, no? The blood of enemies, of friends...

spans.text: You've long forgotten where that blood flows from, no? The blood of enemies, of friends...

units.rawText: <color=red>Did you truly think that it would all end if you left the battlefield?</color>
units.displayText: Did you truly think that it would all end if you left the battlefield?

spans.text: Did you truly think that it would all end if you left the battlefield?

units.rawText: <color=red>All of that data is still running within those agents' veins, driving the engine of war.</color>
units.displayText: All of that data is still running within those agents' veins, driving the engine of war.

spans.text: All of that data is still running within those agents' veins, driving the engine of war.

units.rawText: <color=red>You wish to atone for your sins with death?</color>
units.displayText: You wish to atone for your sins with death?

spans.text: You wish to atone for your sins with death?

units.rawText: <color=red>Not even death will absolve you of your sin, to say nothing of you being incapable to even reach its embrace.</color>
units.displayText: Not even death will absolve you of your sin, to say nothing of you being incapable to even reach its embrace.

spans.text: Not even death will absolve you of your sin, to say nothing of you being incapable to even reach its embrace.

units.rawText: <color=red>Once again you shall be reset, returned to the cycle of slaughter.</color>
units.displayText: Once again you shall be reset, returned to the cycle of slaughter.

spans.text: Once again you shall be reset, returned to the cycle of slaughter.

units.rawText: <color=red>This fate is one you shall never escape.</color>
units.displayText: This fate is one you shall never escape.

spans.text: This fate is one you shall never escape.
